title: Automated Compliance Audit Orchestration
business: Financial institutions managing complex regulatory reporting requirements.
problem: Manual compliance audits are prone to human error, slow to execute, and struggle to integrate disparate data sources across legacy systems.
solution: The Agent Harness wraps a specialized compliance agent with specific instructions, regulatory tools, and a persistent execution loop to automate data retrieval and validation.
steps: Define the Agent with system instructions tailored to specific financial regulatory frameworks.
Equip the Agent with function tools that interface with internal databases and external APIs.
Implement guardrails to validate that all extracted data meets strict schema requirements before reporting.
Configure a persistent session to maintain context across multi-step audit workflows.
Deploy the Runner to manage the execution loop until the compliance report is finalized.
outcome: Increased consistency in audit reporting and significant reduction in manual processing time for compliance teams.
limitation: The harness relies on the model's ability to interpret instructions correctly; verify this by monitoring the built-in tracing logs for unexpected tool usage patterns.
